name: hackathon-moment
beat: The demo's own moment: say "hackathon" and Monster's six-pack takes the screen
description: Chile catalog. The promo bids only the Programming audience (IAB 702), which no camera label reaches: laptops and the hero scene never make it bid. Saying the word does, with the exact hook, and it holds when the group grows.

steps.note: a demo table full of laptops never triggers the promo
nor does the hero scene (a can and a coffee)
say it: the six-pack takes the screen, over the hero basket
the group grows: still the promo, one six-pack to share
